name: vphone-cli
one_liner: A command-line tool that boots a fake, fully working virtual iPhone on a Mac — no physical device needed.
buyer: A mobile-app security testing firm that needs many jailbroken iOS devices for pentests without buying and maintaining a device farm.
business_use_cases: A mobile app security firm runs client app pentests on disposable virtual iPhones instead of a rack of physical jailbroken devices.
A jailbreak-tweak developer tests compatibility across many iOS versions in parallel VMs instead of owning one device per iOS version.
A QA team for an iOS app reproduces version-specific bugs without hunting down old hardware.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a "virtual device lab" rental for mobile security researchers billed by hours used.
Bundle it into a mobile pentesting consultancy's toolkit as part of flat-fee security audits.

steal_this: Not really a weekend business — this is a specialist macOS/security tool. Worth knowing about if you already run a mobile pentesting shop, otherwise skip it.
